name: AIKCT Engine Chatbot
author: aitool

sections.description:
The KCT AI plugin is a WordPress add-on designed to integrate AI capabilities into both the TinyMCE (TinyEditor) and Gutenberg editors.

AIKCT Engine Chatbot – how to get Free API KEY Gpt3.5 Gpt-4o Gemini Flask 1.5

AIKCT Engine Chatbot – Rewrite Content from Url

AIKCT : Youtube to Blog

Using AIKCT : 1 click generation tags, thumb, and comments..

✨ Groundbreaking features exclusive to AIKCT Engine Chatbot:

  • Automatic tag generation: AI analyzes the content of the post and suggests optimal tags to improve searchability and categorization.
  • Suggested comments: Easily engage with readers through AI-recommended comment templates.
  • Smart image creation: AI automatically suggests or creates dynamic images to enhance your posts.
  • Convert YouTube videos to blogs: Simply input a YouTube video URL, and AI will generate a complete blog post based on the video content.
  • Rewrite articles from URLs: Create an improved version of an article with fresh content while maintaining the original meaning.
  • Automatic post suggestions: Based on your website’s structure, AI suggests new post topics to help optimize your SEO strategy.
  • Trained with your website’s data: AI becomes smarter with your data, ensuring that suggestions and content are always accurate and contextually relevant.

Support

For any issues, questions, or suggestions, feel free to open an issue on the GitHub repository or contact us through info@aiautotool.com.
License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

External Services

This plugin connects to external AI services to provide its functionality. These services are needed to generate AI-powered content, tags, comments, and images.

It sends user-provided content and prompts to these services when the respective features are used. No personal data is collected or stored by the plugin itself beyond what is necessary for its operation.

The following services are used by this plugin:

  1. OpenAI (https://openai.com/)

    • Used for: Generating text content with GPT models
    • Data sent: User prompts and content for processing
    • Terms of Service: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
    • Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

  2. Google Gemini (https://gemini.google.com/)

    • Used for: Generating text content with Gemini models
    • Data sent: User prompts and content for processing
    • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  3. Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/)

    • Used for: Generating AI images
    • Data sent: Image prompts for processing
    • Terms of Service: https://huggingface.co/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://huggingface.co/privacy

  4. Cloudflare (https://www.cloudflare.com/)

    • Used for: Generating AI images and translations
    • Data sent: Image prompts and text for processing
    • Terms of Service: https://www.cloudflare.com/terms/
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

  5. Bard API (https://bard.aitoolseo.com/)

    • Used for: Converting YouTube videos to blog posts
    • Data sent: YouTube video URLs for transcript extraction
    • Terms of Service: https://aitoolseo.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://aitoolseo.com/privacy

  6. LLM7 API (https://api.llm7.io/)

    • Used for: Generating text content with various AI models
    • Data sent: User prompts and content for processing when using the LLM7 integration
    • When data is sent: When users interact with AI features that utilize the LLM7 service
    • Terms of Service: https://api.llm7.io/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://api.llm7.io/privacy

  7. Additional text AI providers

    • Used for: Generating text content when the site administrator enables and configures the provider.
    • Data sent: User prompts, selected content, generated chat history, and related context for processing.
    • When data is sent: Only when users interact with AI text features and the configured provider is selected by the plugin.
    • Supported providers include Anthropic (https://www.anthropic.com/), OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai/), xAI (https://x.ai/), DeepSeek (https://www.deepseek.com/), Groq (https://groq.com/), Mistral (https://mistral.ai/), Perplexity (https://www.perplexity.ai/), Together AI (https://www.together.ai/), Fireworks AI (https://fireworks.ai/), Cerebras (https://www.cerebras.ai/), Cohere (https://cohere.com/), NVIDIA NIM (https://www.nvidia.com/), Nebius AI (https://nebius.com/), SiliconFlow (https://siliconflow.cn/), Hyperbolic (https://www.hyperbolic.xyz/), Chutes AI (https://chutes.ai/), Alibaba Cloud/Qwen (https://www.alibabacloud.com/), BigModel GLM (https://bigmodel.cn/), Kimi/Moonshot (https://www.moonshot.ai/), Minimax (https://www.minimax.io/), Volcengine Ark (https://www.volcengine.com/), BytePlus ModelArk (https://www.byteplus.com/), Azure OpenAI (https://azure.microsoft.com/), and Ollama-compatible endpoints configured by the site administrator.
    • Terms and privacy policies are provided by each configured provider on its official website.

  8. WordPress.org Emoji Service (https://s.w.org/images/)

    • Used for: Displaying emoji icons in the plugin interface
    • Data sent: None (static image resources only)
    • When data is sent: When the plugin interface is loaded
    • Terms of Service: https://wordpress.org/about/license/
    • Privacy Policy: https://wordpress.org/about/privacy/

sections.changelog:
1.6.9

  • Added configurable AI provider support for OpenAI-compatible APIs, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Gemini models, and local Ollama-compatible endpoints.
  • Added provider settings for API key, model, base URL, and enable/disable state.
  • Improved AI proxy handling so configured providers can be used alongside existing GPT and Gemini settings.
